centered_metric_definition: For each paired prefix subtract its mean raw537 delta from every coordinate; aggregate RMS pools these per-prefix centered squared deltas.
interpretation: Cross-row raw scores at identical checkpoint and prefix measure response to the two declared numeric conditioning inputs. Grammar argmax/margins and allowed sets are recorded separately. This does not identify why source meanings reconstruct incorrectly.
selection_mask_scope: All grammar_* metric keys refer to the recorded public scope, grammar and completion-budget allowed set, not an unbudgeted grammar mask.
source_flow: Qualified runtime gives context only to grammar/budget selection and typed decoding; PreparedModel restores checkpoint plus conditioning and forwards vector plus prefix. Context is not a direct neural input, although it can alter selected prefixes.
